description.value: Bishop's Family Cycles is a Victoria cargo-bike specialist situated directly on the Blanshard bike lane between Yates and Johnson streets, making it easily accessible by bicycle. Founded by a family of active cyclists transplanted from Ontario and the US, the shop focuses on helping families, new commuters, and car-replacement cyclists find the right cargo, electric, and kids bikes from brands like Riese & Müller and Tern. They also carry a practical range of parts and tools — tubes, tires, brakes, pumps, and saddles — useful to a cyclist passing through.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (23 spaces, covered) at 28m; stands (4 spaces) at 44m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at familycycles.ca is fully accessible and confirms the Victoria location at 1317 Blanshard St with phone 778-600-0878, matching OSM tags. The site identifies Bishop's as a cargo bike specialist stocking tires, tubes, brakes, pumps, and other parts; the 'Work With Us' page confirms they hire for 'sales and basic maintenance,' indicating repair work is performed, but no website text explicitly offers urgent triage or a public floor pump for visiting cyclists. Electric bikes (Riese & Müller Multicharger2, etc.) are sold but e-bike servicing for customers is not explicitly stated.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Sa-Su 09:00-17:00) differs from website contact page (Sat & Sun 10am to 5pm); OSM may be stale despite the 2026-04-28 check_date.
Business operates a second location in Vancouver (1683 Chestnut St); the OSM record and this listing cover the Victoria location only — ensure no duplicate record exists for the Vancouver site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, independently verified bike shop on a major Victoria bike lane, stocking parts relevant to touring cyclists and staffed with mechanics; a clear fit for the WWC directory pending a follow-up call to confirm walk-in repair availability.
enrichment_extras.notes: The 'Work With Us' page confirms a 'sales and basic maintenance' role at the Victoria location, suggesting repair services exist, but the website never explicitly advertises walk-in repairs or urgent mechanical assistance — a direct inquiry is recommended before asserting those amenities.
